@graph.howPerformed: Your dermatologist first evaluates your skin and treatment goals. The area is cleansed and a conductive gel is applied, then a handheld device delivers controlled RF energy to the targeted area. Moisturizer and sunscreen are applied afterwards. Each session typically lasts 30–60 minutes, depending on the area treated.

acceptedAnswer.text: Most clients feel only a warm, soothing sensation during the treatment.

mainEntity.name: How long does a session take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Each session typically lasts 30–60 minutes, depending on the area treated.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions will I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: A series of four to six sessions spaced a few weeks apart is typically recommended.
Some people have mild redness, swelling or temporary discomfort, which usually subsides within a few hours.
